parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4304757. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
